svg.title: Hyrum's law
svg.desc: A billing script calls GET /invoices and emails invoices[0] as the latest invoice. The docs never promise an order, but the old Postgres query walks the created_at index, so the newest comes first. After a migration to 4 sharded servers the results come back grouped by server, the docs are unchanged, and the script emails last year's invoice to 3,000 people.
svg.text: Nobody promised newest first, but 40 billing scripts depended on it.
